name: low-stock-alert
description: Warns the team in Slack when a product's stock drops to a threshold, and can draft a reorder email to the supplier for you to approve.

howItWorks.label: Does
howItWorks.text: Posts the products that just ran low to Slack, with recent sales and days of cover

howItWorks.label: Optional
howItWorks.text: Drafts a purchase order email to each supplier with Resend

plugins.reason: Posts the low-stock alert to your team's channel
Emails a reorder request to the supplier once you approve it

data.description: The SKU, so the team and supplier know exactly which item
A per-product threshold, when the store keeps one (overrides the default threshold)
The supplier the product is bought from, with a contact email
Order line items (product and quantity), to work out recent sales

parameters.label: Low-stock threshold
parameters.description: Alert when stock is at or below this, unless the product has its own reorder point

parameters.label: Reorder for this many days
parameters.description: The suggested reorder quantity covers this many days of recent sales

parameters.label: Draft supplier emails
parameters.description: Draft a reorder email per supplier (needs Resend); nothing is sent without approval
